name: JonathanSalwan/ROPgadget
description: A tool for finding ROP gadgets in ELF, PE, and Mach-O binaries across x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, PowerPC, SPARC, MIPS, and RISC-V architectures to facilitate Return Oriented Programming exploitation.
score_rationale: Essential ROP gadget finder with 4.4k stars, actively updated through October 2025 with broad architecture support.
